title: Neighbor Spoofing in US Scam Call Complaints
description: Summary of US consumer scam and unwanted call complaints, grouped by caller number, measuring how often the caller shared the consumer's own area code. 37.5% overall, 45.6% excluding toll-free callers. Full analysis: https://thescamexposed.com/neighbor-spoofing. Limitations: complaints are consumer reported and unverified, caller ID can be spoofed, topic assignment is approximate.
